_note: Every tuning number in one place (Logan tunes; Claude's values are Proposed). Read through scripts/core/Balance.gd. Rerun the sim after changes: tools/balance_sim.sh.

combat._why: Logan 2026-09-30: fights should run about 6 turns. Applied to every Refit Bay part as it loads (ComponentLibrary), player and enemy alike, so card faces show the scaled numbers; Refit Bay keeps the originals. damage_mult scales each card's damage range (rounded, at least 1). heat_add is added to every card that costs heat (Logan: +1 across the board); vent cards (negative cost) and free cards (protocols, Quick Draw) keep theirs. hp_mult scales every part's HP (rounded): with damage_mult 0.75 and heat_add 1 it brings fights to about 6 turns (Logan's target; sim, Bastion and Jackal, 2026-09-30). heat_mult then scales the heat cost of damage-dealing cards that cost heat (rounded).

heat._why: Ratio venting: at max heat (or over) this share vents; below max it scales down with the heat % (Logan, 2026-09-28).
heat._why_vent_action: The Vent action (Proposed default, 2026-09-30): a mech that spends its turn venting (the player before playing any card; an enemy with nothing it can play) vents this share of its heat at its next dispersal, as if it were at max.

economy._scraps_why: Doubled 2026-09-30 (Logan: double the scrap so shops are worth it; runs are twice as long too).
economy._shop_note: Shop rework (Logan 2026-09-29/30: more options to buy from, no rerolls): shop_offers parts per category, each rolled for rarity; any part in Cargo or on the bench sells for its scrap value; once a visit, refine a part into a random one of its type one rarity up (refine_prices by its current rarity).
economy._scrap_note: Proposed (Claude, 2026-09-28): a part left on the refit / autonomous bay workbench is scrapped for scrap_fraction of its price, times its HP share.
economy._skip_why: Skipping a salvage pick pays scraps (Logan, 2026-09-30: 10). At least the sell value of the cheapest part offered, so taking a part only to sell it never beats skipping.

map._event_shop_note: Logan, 2026-09-30: some event stops turn out to be an abandoned autonomous bay (a shop), this often.

encounters._note: Slay-the-Spire style: a run's first `weak_fights` regular fights draw from the location's weak pool, the rest from its strong pool (a mission can override). An encounter isn't repeated within `no_repeat` fights.

enemy_ai._self_cost_note: How much an enemy's card choice counts what the card costs its own part (EnemyAI._self_cost): subtracted from its score. self_offline_penalty for taking the part Offline for the rest of the fight (Precision Throw), self_disable_penalty per turn of Disabled or Freeze (Wrap Up). 0 = ignored (the AI before 2026-09-30). Claude's proposal for Logan: 30 and 0 (Balance Targets; a Disable penalty made Cipher easier).

meta._note: Chips: the meta currency (Logan, 2026-09-28). A day of 1-2 hours ≈ 2-3 runs + that day's Directives; a cosmetic should take several days.
meta._chips_why: Halved 2026-09-30 (Logan: runs are longer, and Directives should be the main way to earn Chips).
meta._memorial_note: War Room Memorial Wall (Logan: starts empty, grows a bit every run and more per elite and boss). Its first trophy (the candle) shows at 1 point, then one more per memorial_per_trophy points, up to all 14. Point values are Proposed.
meta._weekly_note: Weekly directives and streaks (Claude, 2026-09-30, Proposed): weekly_per_week goals a week; finishing all of a day's directives on consecutive days pays streak_chips_per_day × the streak's days (capped at streak_max_days).

orders._x2_note: 2026-09-30: runs doubled and scraps doubled, so Claude's scrap grants (Supply Drop, Loan Shark, Blind Drop) and fight-count durations (Cold Start, Wider Picks, Loan Shark, Hot Insertion) were doubled too. Logan's own numbers (Stripped Frame 200) are unchanged: vet.
orders._note: Deployment orders (Logan, 2026-09-29): after Launch the Operator offers three, one boost, one tradeoff and one gamble (anything random is a gamble), shown in a shuffled order without saying which is which. Numbers are Proposed (Claude) unless Logan gave them. Names and text are in data/orders.json. Orders that hand out parts open the run with a refit, with Cargo 5×5 for that refit (Logan, 2026-09-29).

modular_chassis._why: Logan's numbers; the HP cut is only on the parts you launch with (Logan, 2026-09-29), so swapping them out escapes it (a part keeps at least 1)

blind_drop._why: Logan 2026-09-29: planning matters, so it needs a huge upside; you still see two rows ahead

orders._2026_09_30_note: Claude's 9 new orders (2026-09-30, Proposed): built only from effects the other orders already use. One order a run, so orders never stack (Logan, 2026-09-30).

conditions._note: Location modifiers and mission variants (data/conditions.json), Proposed (Claude, 2026-09-30). variant_weights: how often each variant rolls. Sim (builder, 200 runs): with Rain 10% / Jam 1 / Smoke 2 clears fell ~8 points; at Rain 5% / Jam 1 / Smoke 1 about 2-4 (Jamming is most of it).

daily._note: Daily Operation score (Claude's draft, 2026-09-30, Proposed): points per stop, elite and boss, a bonus for clearing, and 1 point per damage_per_point damage dealt.
